CustomField.description: Shortened project name (PPPPP segment). Auto-filled from ProjectName__c with whitespace removed, uppercased, first 5 characters (e.g. "TE 30 AA" -> "TE30A") when blank; a manually entered value is preserved.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Short code for the project name (PPPPP segment). Defaults to the first 5 letters of the Project Name; you may override it.
CustomField.label: Short Project Name
